offences.label: Riding a motor cycle without protective headgear

central_law.provision: MV Act 1988 s.129 read with s.194D (inserted by Act 32 of 2019, s.79)
central_law.penalty_text: Fine of one thousand rupees and disqualification from holding a licence for three months

state_compounding.settle_with: The current Government of NCT of Delhi notification under s.200(1). Press reports describe a notification of 13 Mar 2020 and a September 2024 decision to compound at 50 per cent of the challan amount; neither official text was found on transport.delhi.gov.in on 27 Sep 2026. The Delhi Gazette (Part IV, Extraordinary) is the settling source.

offences.label: Using a handheld communication device while driving

central_law.provision: MV Act 1988 s.184, Explanation (c) (inserted by Act 32 of 2019, s.67); compounding under s.200(1) limited to this use (Act 32 of 2019, s.86)
central_law.penalty_text: First offence: imprisonment of six months to one year, or fine of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000, or both. Second or subsequent offence within three years: imprisonment up to two years, or fine of ten thousand rupees, or both.
central_law.note: Earphones or headphones for music are not named in s.184 or the Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations 2017. See docs/FINDINGS.md, claim C2.

state_compounding.settle_with: The current Government of NCT of Delhi notification under s.200(1). Press reports describe a notification of 13 Mar 2020 and a September 2024 decision to compound at 50 per cent of the challan amount; neither official text was found on transport.delhi.gov.in on 27 Sep 2026. The Delhi Gazette (Part IV, Extraordinary) is the settling source.

central_law.provision: MV Act 1988 s.184, Explanation (a) (inserted by Act 32 of 2019, s.67)
central_law.penalty_text: Listed as driving dangerously: first offence imprisonment of six months to one year, or fine of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000, or both.
central_law.note: s.200(1) as amended allows s.184 to be compounded only for handheld-device use, so a spot amount for red-light jumping needs a different legal basis.
